claims.statement: Both Perl boundary scanner and lowerer preserve complete quoted atoms through one shared private decoder, with their original outer grammar/raw calls and quote/backslash/empty-label behavior. 4346 original regular Git inputs, three new before overlays and four after overlays/two exact owner replacements support eight guarded commands.18 literal cases retain28 events per seed under three seeds;14 compiler cases retain scanner/substitution/descriptor/parser-source/runtime channels. Original RED9 becomes GREEN18; nine focused suites pass1169 top-level groups including Phase01034.13 runtime cases succeed; the nested unknown-escape case remains an explicitly observed P1 exclusion with two skipped runtime assertions.36 distinguishing evidence controls and nine rendered-book controls observe RED. Complete58-input book renders two examples/three sections;37 prior claim inputs verify before historical freeze.
claims.scope: Existing Perl quoted-or-bare boundary helper contract at clean da5c8d1f66732f0989cecca745557005fe44e7c1. Independent literal labels/raw calls/cumulative Unicode-CRLF repeated scalar intervals and runtime values establish the delimiter correction without new rule-definition syntax or general CSV admission. Source delta whitelist preserves all bytes outside the exact two original decode loops and shared imports; shared function matching preserves caller regex scope. Public boundary event schema remains unchanged; no provenance sidecars are added. Before/after public channels differ only in whole-label metadata/emission and three diagnosed phantom-boundary runtime values. Dynamic trace timestamps are retained but excluded from seed equality; the escaped-comma assignment trace is independently required to show actual normalization/source_span_missing. Its full parser remains unresolved and is scheduled as P1 SPEC-LANGUAGE-SELF-CONTAINMENT.1.3.3.0.7.2.2.0.1.4.0.1.1 immediately after this commit, before anonymous capture. Two runtime fixture assertions explicitly skip only that owner; scanner/direct substitution remain tested. Other backends escape parity, zero-argument behavior, executable membership, remaining Legacy families and historical global audit are unassessed/separately owned. Full regular Git snapshots are a conservative parent-owned input population, not minimal observed IO; Gitlink/nonregular metadata exclude payload reads. Published dependencies and read-only host OS/Perl/Python/prove/mdBook remain execution prerequisites; all project data remains on repository volume. No dependency internals, other repositories, pins, CI/hooks or storage mechanisms change. Focused proof does not claim canonical CI; family .1.4.7 and push retain canonical boundaries.
